title: Failure to deflate endotracheal tube cuff due to improper fixation
abstract:
We report an interesting case, where improper fixation of the endotracheal tube resulted in the  malfunctioning of the endotracheal tube thereby causing extubation of the trachea with an inflated cuff. A slight carelessness on the part of anaesthesia residents can result  in  life threatening complications for the patient.

DOI: http://dx.doi.org/10.4038/slja.v21i2.5266
